Marking up the technical and compliance pieces below (keeping it concise so Alex can forward to Lumen).

1) Segmentation approach\- Per-tenant segregation is implemented via dedicated prefixes and per-tenant KMS envelope keys. Logs are written to tenant-specific S3 prefixes (s3://redwood-logs/{tenant-id}/YYYY/MM/DD/) with bucket policies enforcing tenant ACLs. For private deployments we also support per-tenant VPC routing and tenant-only EBS volumes.

2) Certified deletion workflow (summary)
- Deletion request received (API or CS ticket) -> validate ownership and scope -> create deletion job.
- Deletion job enumerates objects and writes a deletion-manifest.csv listing object key, deletion timestamp, and SHA256 of the object (pre-delete).
- Objects are permanently removed; cloud-provider delete markers are validated. A signed attestation containing the deletion-manifest hash is generated and stored in our immutable audit-store (WORM bucket) for 365 days by default; retention can be adjusted per contract.

3) Legal hold / exception handling
- Holds are an explicit flag on tenant metadata. When set, lifecycle deletion is suspended and manifests reflect hold status. Removal of hold requires dual-approval (compliance + legal). We log hold changes to the tenant audit stream and include those entries in the attestation record.

4) Proof artifacts we can provide
- deletion-manifest-sample.csv (sanitized) — shows key, pre-delete-hash, deletion-timestamp, operator-id.
- s3-lifecycle-policy.json (the policy applied to the tenant prefix).
- sample attestation PDF: signed hash of manifest + internal signature metadata (created by our signing service).
- mapping doc describing log families and retention buckets.

Notes:
- For highly regulated customers who cannot accept even transient copies, we offer dedicated capacity/private deployment options with shorter ephemeral buffers and explicit KMS separation.
- We cannot provide raw PHI logs; we will provide sanitized samples and cryptographic proofs.

I'll attach the deletion manifest sample and lifecycle policy JSON to this thread. Marissa — can you prepare the attestation sample and the short write-up for Alex? I will draft the legal hold language for signature.

Thanks,
Priya
Director, Compliance & Privacy — Redwood Inference
